FarmGoConnect

Product overview

Fresh produce, straight from Kenyan farms to the kitchens that need it.

What FarmGo Connect is today, who it serves, and everything it can do, explained without the technical detail.

By EYAAM Version 1.0, ready for tester release October 2026

FarmGo Connect is a youth-led, demand-led marketplace. It connects smallholder farmers and youth agri-enterprises directly with hotels, restaurants, households and other buyers in Kenya. Buyers get fresh produce that has been checked for quality. Farmers learn what the market needs before they plant, sell without middlemen, and are paid quickly by M-Pesa.

1

What FarmGo Connect Is

Kenyan food supply has four stubborn problems, and FarmGo Connect was built to solve all four:

Farmers plant blindThey grow without knowing what buyers will need, so prices crash and produce is wasted.
Buyers juggle middlemenHotels and restaurants buy through many brokers, with uneven quality and late deliveries.
Surplus goes to wasteWhen supply outruns what buyers need that day, good food is lost.
Youth are left outYoung people have few ways into the better-paid parts of farming.

The big idea is simple. FarmGo flips the usual order: demand comes first.

The usual way

  1. Farmer grows produce
  2. Farmer goes looking for a buyer
  3. Price is whatever a broker offers
  4. Whatever does not sell is wasted

The FarmGo way

  1. Buyers say what they will need
  2. FarmGo adds up demand by area and week
  3. Farmers plant and list to match it
  4. Orders are matched, checked, delivered and paid

Everyone uses the same app. Each person sees the screens that fit their role.

3

How It Works

Every order follows the same journey, and everyone can see where it is at each step.

Buyer ordersFrom a listing, a cart across several farmers, or a regular requirement.
Farmer confirmsOn the app or by USSD on any phone.
Harvest readyThe farmer reports the harvest is in.
Quality checkAn inspector grades it. Only good produce goes out.
On the roadGrouped into a route; the buyer can follow it.
DeliveredPhoto and signature as proof of delivery.
Buyer confirmsRates the farmer, or reports a problem with photos.
Farmer paidStraight to M-Pesa once the order is settled.
Money is held safely in between. The buyer pays when they order. FarmGo holds the payment until the produce has arrived and the buyer has had a short window to report a problem. Only then is the farmer paid. If produce fails inspection or arrives short, the buyer is refunded for what they did not get.
4

For Buyers

Finding produce

  • Eight simple categories on the home screen: Vegetables, Fruits, Meat and Poultry, Dairy, Grains and Staples, Value Added, Natural Fertilizers, and All Products.
  • Search that forgives typos, in English or Kiswahili, by produce or farm name.
  • Sort by nearest, by price or by newest. Every listing shows how far away the farm is.
  • Rich listing pages show photos, the farmer's rating and quality record, and how the price compares with this week's market price. Labels mark produce as fresh, organic or local, and similar listings nearby are suggested.
  • Farmer profiles show farm photos, ratings, completed orders and badges such as youth-led, woman-led, organic and verified. Phone numbers and exact farm locations stay private.
  • Featured farmers are picked for good ratings, strong quality records and recent activity.

Ordering and paying

  • One cart, many farmers. Buyers add produce from several farms and check out once, with one delivery fee and one payment.
  • Delivery slots. Buyers choose a morning or afternoon window. Orders placed before 4 p.m. can arrive the next day.
  • Saved addresses, with a default address used for delivery and for "nearest" searches.
  • Pay by M-Pesa or card. Approved businesses can also buy on monthly invoices with credit terms.
  • Reorder in one tap at today's prices. FarmGo says clearly if anything is no longer available.

Planning ahead

  • Requirements. Post a one-off or regular need, such as 50 kg of tomatoes every week. FarmGo matches it with farmers who can supply it.
  • Pause and resume a regular requirement during quiet seasons, without losing it.
  • A home dashboard shows orders, this month's spending, active deliveries, upcoming requirements, invoices due and favourites.
  • Favourites for farmers, produce, categories and listings.
5

For Farmers

Sell in a minute

List a harvest with photos, quantity, price and dates. A price hint shows what the market is paying this week.

See what buyers need

The demand board shows which buyers nearby want what, and when, so farmers can plant for real demand.

Get matched

When a buyer's need fits a listing, the farmer is offered a match to accept or decline.

Manage orders

Confirm orders and mark the harvest ready, or undo it if the harvest is not in yet, before inspection.

Know your earnings

Monthly earnings, FarmGo's fee and what is still on its way, plus every M-Pesa payout with its receipt.

Manage farms and listings

Several farms with photos and map pins. Listings can be edited, closed and reopened later.

A farmer's home dashboard shows active listings, orders received, sales this month, their rating, and any action waiting: matches to answer, orders to confirm, harvests due within two days and payouts pending.

Field agents can register farmers who are new to smartphones, add their farms, upload ID documents for verification, and help them sell.

  • Register as a farmer with just a name and county.
  • Sell produce: choose the crop, quantity, when it will be ready and the price.
  • See buyer demand in their county for the coming weeks.

7

Quality You Can Trust

  • Every order is inspected before it leaves the farm. Inspectors see the orders waiting in their counties.
  • Each item is graded and recorded with photos, a checklist and notes, including how much was accepted or rejected.
  • Only produce that passes goes out. Buyers are refunded automatically for anything rejected.
  • Inspection results build each farmer's quality record, which buyers see on listings and profiles.
  • If something is wrong on arrival, buyers report a problem with photos within the problem window. The team reviews it and refunds part or all of the order where needed.
8

Delivery and Tracking

  • Inspected orders are grouped into delivery routes by area and delivery window, then assigned to a driver and vehicle.
  • Drivers get a clear list of stops: pickups at farms and drop-offs at buyers, with produce names in Kiswahili and the buyer's contact for drop-offs.
  • Buyers follow the delivery live, with the driver's location while the route is under way.
  • Proof of delivery: a photo and signature at every drop-off. A stop that fails is put back for the next route.
  • Reusable crates carry each crate's QR code, so every crate can be tracked from farm to kitchen and back.
9

Payments and Payouts

Buyers pay

By M-Pesa (a payment prompt appears on the phone), by card through a secure hosted page, or by monthly invoice for approved businesses. All amounts are in Kenya shillings.

Farmers get paid

Straight to their M-Pesa number once an order is delivered and settled, minus FarmGo's fee. Every payout has an M-Pesa receipt in the app.

  • Every payment is double-checked with M-Pesa or the card provider before an order is marked paid. A missing confirmation is picked up automatically later.
  • Refunds are automatic for cancelled orders, rejected produce and settled problems.
  • No double charges. A payment retried on a weak connection is only taken once.
  • The team can record bank transfers and cash against an order code or invoice number.
  • Suppliers of natural farm inputs see their own sales and payouts too.
10

Market Prices and Planning

  • A weekly price index per produce and county, built from real sales on FarmGo.
  • Demand forecasts for the coming weeks, so farmers can plan what to plant.
  • Price hints when listing, and a comparison with the market price on every listing.
  • When buyers in an area need something nobody is offering, nearby farmers are told.
11

Natural Farm Inputs

A second marketplace inside FarmGo, run by youth enterprises. It sells compost, organic fertilizer, natural pest control and seedlings to farmers.

  • Suppliers keep a catalogue with stock levels and get warned when stock runs low.
  • Farmers order and pay by M-Pesa. Suppliers accept, dispatch and deliver.
  • Problems can be reported with photos, just like produce orders.
12

Messages and Notifications

  • Chat on every order between the buyer's team and the farmer, with photos and read receipts.
  • A messages inbox lists every conversation, newest first, with unread counts.
  • Notifications by app, SMS or email for the moments that matter: a new order, a match, a payment received, an inspection result or a delivery on its way. Tapping one opens the right screen.
  • Live updates: order status, chat and driver location update on screen without refreshing.
13

Running the Marketplace

The FarmGo team has an admin console in the same app, built for a desktop screen.

People and businesses

Approve businesses, set payment terms for trusted buyers, review farmer ID documents, and change roles or suspend accounts.

Orders and problems

See every order, review reported problems with their photos, and settle them with a refund where needed.

Money

Payments, invoices and payouts across the whole marketplace, with totals. Record cash or bank payments and retry a failed payout.

Catalogue and settings

Manage the produce list, delivery fee, delivery windows, FarmGo's fee and other business settings.

Matching and routes

Create matches by hand, plan delivery routes and manage the crate fleet.

View as a user

See exactly what a user sees, to help them. Moving money is blocked while viewing as someone else.

14

Built for Everyone

  • Every screen size: Android phones, iPhones, tablets, foldables and desktop browsers, with layouts made for each.
  • English and Kiswahili throughout the app, switched with one tap.
  • Sign in with just a phone number and a one-time code, or with email and password.
  • Works on weak connections: actions taken offline are sent when the connection returns, without being doubled.
  • Light and dark mode, and labels for screen readers.
  • Your data, your choice: anyone can download a copy of their data or delete their account from the app. Orders and payments are kept for accounting with the person removed.
15

Trust, Safety and Reliability

Safe accounts

Codes expire quickly and attempts are limited. Suspended accounts are signed out at once. Each person only sees what their role allows.

Private by default

Farmers' phone numbers, exact locations, dates of birth and ID documents are never shown to buyers. Sensitive details are kept out of system logs.

Money protected

Payments are confirmed with the provider, charges are never taken twice, and money is held until delivery is settled.

Always on, even when busy

The service adds capacity on its own when it gets busy, and updates go out without interrupting anyone.

Backed up every night

Data and photos are copied to a second, separate location every night. Restoring them is practised regularly.

Checked on every change

Hundreds of automated tests run on every change, along with security checks on everything the app depends on.
